# Confident Creator

> Camera confidence training and AI video creation tools helping aspiring creators, coaches, educators, and entrepreneurs go from camera-shy to camera-confident.

- Website: https://confidentcreator.app/
- Android App (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.confidentcam.confident_cam
- Companion Web Portal: https://confidentcreator.app/login.html
- Platforms: Android (Live), Web Portal (Live), iOS (Planned / Coming Soon)
- Current Pricing: Free on Google Play and free companion Web Portal access

## Core Product Overview
- [Homepage](https://confidentcreator.app/): Overview of problems solved, workflow, verified features, app screenshots, target audience, and FAQs.
- [About Confident Creator](https://confidentcreator.app/about-confident-creator/): Complete factual product reference covering supported platforms, 30-day challenge structure, AI script generator (12 languages incl. Hinglish and Tanglish), lens & voice teleprompter, local video privacy, and support.
